kpis.label: River WQ Status
kpis.sublabel: derived, CCME WQI, 12 months to Oct 2026 (area-weighted)
kpis.methodNote: Derived: the CCME Water Quality Index (CCME 2001) of each district over the trailing 12 months of the 14 guideline parameters in 12.1–12.3, WQI = 100 − √(F1² + F2² + F3²) / 1.732 with F1 = % of parameters failing, F2 = % of tests failing and F3 = the scaled excursion from the guideline (thresholds.json `wq_guidelines`); area-weighted for a scope and null below 4 parameters. The value is the Water Quality page's WQI: one index per district, one record per district, no sampling sites.
